chrome.note: progressive H.264 with AAC 5.1, MKV and MP4: direct play, no TranscodeReasons

note: results[file][profile@MaxStreamingBitrate]. audio is the stream as the PlaybackInfo reply lists it, which reports the channels it will deliver (2 for 5.1 under chrome); sourceAudio has the file's own. All files: 20 s, 640x360 interlaced (tff) H.264, keyframe every 72 frames. MKV files carry no per-track bitrate; the 128000/192000 are what Jellyfin reports (it measures).
